about: Sanitized Turkish call scenarios for the live-voice bench. Synthetic text only: no recording of a person, no private project content. Each scenario is one caller turn (or none) built from segments; pause_ms is the silence after a segment. A pause inside one turn is a thinking pause the call must not end the turn on. 'reference' is what a perfect recogniser writes, used for WER.
